name: Conical Reflected Features
aliases: Conical Reflected Features — Directional Sampling, Reflection Feature Downweighting
definition: Estimate the expected volume-rendered feature over a vMF distribution of reflected rays to decode into reflected color, avoiding prohibitively expensive Monte Carlo integration.
summary: Conical Reflected Features efficiently decodes reflected color by sampling a von Mises-Fisher distribution, avoiding Monte Carlo costs and preventing distant aliasing through directional feature downweighting.
